notes.title: Update Notes Feb 1, 2025:
notes.notes:
Areas/levels:
- Added new small area (achievements and unlock) accessible through main menu in which you can see most achievements and the unlocks they are linked to
- Minor layout changes in area 1 lava

Visuals:
- Added a few more skins
- Added accessories (attachments to your character). Have to be unlocked via achievements
- Improved Emotes

notes.title: Big Update with new area and a lot of changes 26th Jan, 2025
notes.notes:
Area 1 Updates:
- Added Indicators to portal entries
- Added new Doodads to enhance visuals
- Minor layout changes

New Area 2:
- Introduced a new snow-themed area with new mechanics like moving blocks and deadly projectiles

Achievements System:
- Added achievements to reward player progress
- Achievements are now linked to visual rewards like skins for the character, emotes or accessories

Skins:
- Introduced new skins
- Skins are now linked to achievements, encouraging exploration and challenges

Music and Audio:
- Added new songs to the playlists
- Introduced a "next Song" button for better playlist control
- Added an option to repeat the current song
- Added "song intensity" setting in the options audio menu
- Added an option to toggle between ordered and random sequence of the songlist

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed an issue where no song would play occasionally
- Fixed a bug where music would stop playing at volume 0
- Resolved a bug where music volume was slightly above 0 at slider position 0
- Area 1 level 15 and 18 block visibility issues have been resolved

UI and Layout Improvements:
- Updated menu backgrounds and redesigned menu buttons

Technical Improvements:
- Drastically improved code quality for better performance and maintainability (probably no visible changes to players)
